1 February 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : Imperial Japanese Government
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo
SUBJECT : Use of Silver for Industrial Purposes
1. Reference is made to C.L.O. Memorandum No. 284 (2.1), dated 18 January 1946, subject: "Control of Financial Transactions," and the attached application for the use of 5,200 fine grams of silver by the Fuji Film Co., No. 3 Nishi 2 Cho-me, Ginza, Tokyo, in the manufacture of film, printing paper and plates.
2. This application may be approved.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
